# Protocol membership invitation API endpoint
{: .no_toc}



## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** not available
- **Response keys:** `protocolmembershipinvitation` (detail, create, update), `protocolmembershipinvitations` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `invitee` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[required]** |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id **[required]** |
| `can_change` | boolean |
| `manage_protocol` | boolean |
| `own_protocol` | boolean |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('protocolmembershipinvitation', load_all=True)
records = resp['protocolmembershipinvitations']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('protocolmembershipinvitation', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.protocolmembershipinvitations;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "protocolmembershipinvitations": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "invitee": "<user-id>",
            "protocol": "<protocol-id>",
            "can_change": true,
            "manage_protocol": true,
            "own_protocol": true
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('protocolmembershipinvitation', data={"invitee": "<user-id>", "protocol": "<protocol-id>"})
record = resp.json()['protocolmembershipinvitation']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('invitee', '<user-id>', 'protocol', '<protocol-id>'), 'protocolmembershipinvitation');
record = created.protocolmembershipinvitation;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('protocolmembershipinvitation', id='<id>', data={"can_change": True})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'can_change', true), 'protocolmembershipinvitation', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python

```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)


## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `accept_invitation` | POST `/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/<id>/accept/` |
| `cancel_invitation` | POST `/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/<id>/cancel/` |
| `reject_invitation` | POST `/api/private/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/<id>/reject/` |
